documents.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules

chunks.content:
3.6. Captains are expected to prioritize players from the local community ahead of those from
outside the community. As a community-based league, we emphasize the inclusion of
local players over non-local players.
3.7. Players are permitted to join or substitute for multiple community teams within the same
community, provided that all League and DUPR rating regulations are adhered to.

chunks.heading: TEAM/GAME RULES
chunks.content:
5. TEAM/GAME RULES
5.1. Team Structure: A team roster may consist of any number of players who satisfy all
applicable eligibility requirements for that team’s league and division.
5.1.1. There is no maximum roster size. Each team is responsible for maintaining a
suƯicient number of eligible players to meet the required lineup for each scheduled
match. Teams are strongly encouraged to carry additional eligible players to provide
substitutes in the event of player absence or unavailability.
5.1.2. A player may be listed on more than one team roster, provided the player
independently satisfies all eligibility requirements applicable to each team, league,
and division under these League Rules.
5.2. Team Home Court Expectations: All teams registering for league play are expected to
